description: This file provides a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels. It handles string normalization, replacing underscores/hyphens with spaces, collapsing multiple spaces, and converting to Title Case, with special handling for apostrophes. It is intended for use in a frontend dashboard to display statuses in a user-friendly manner.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable label, handling nulls, special characters, and applying Title Case formatting.
